name: UsbHidKeyboardHost
description: USB HID Host for wired keyboards over a USB-OTG adapter — talks directly to ESP-IDF's usb_host driver, enumerates the HID Boot Keyboard interface, and emits raw [keyCode, modifiers, pressed] events. Opt-in per board (FREEINK_CAP_USB_HID_KBD_HOST); links a no-op stub and pulls in no USB Host code when disabled.
keywords: usb, hid, otg, host, keyboard, boot protocol
